description: A wallet's Dice Club bets (yours by default). With `nonce` (from roll_dice): that bet — still pending, or its result re-verified from the revealed seed (roll, won/lost, paid, proof). Without: every pending bet, with how many bets are ahead of it and whether it is refundable (the keeper missed its ~24h deadline — refund_dice_bet). Results older than ~11 days are past the RPC's history. No key needed.

nonce.description: the bet's nonce, as roll_dice returned it

name: get_dice_bets
title: Dice Club bets
